description:
#### Fixed
- **Ads in the home feed** are blocked again on 453. The 453 update missed one part of
  Instagram's changed post parser, so sponsored posts were no longer recognised. Sponsored
  carousels are caught too.

---

Oxbow for Instagram 453.0.0.55.79 (patch bundle 1.1.1).

- **oxbow.apk** replaces Instagram (uninstall Instagram first).
- **oxbow-clone.apk** installs next to Instagram.
- **patches-1.1.1.mpp**: patch Instagram yourself in [Morphe Manager](https://morphe.software): add the source `github.com/aic0d3r/oxbow`.

Obtainium: add `https://github.com/aic0d3r/oxbow` and set the APK filter to `oxbow\.apk$` or `oxbow-clone\.apk$`.

